{{Otheruses|Minelayer}}
A '''minelayer''' was any [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed to deploy [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]] around a specific target.

==Characteristics==
These [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] were necessarily fitted with one or more [[Minelayer|minelaying systems]] and would often be comparatively small [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. The [[Nonvideor-class minelayer|''Nonvideor''-class]] vessel was an example of a minelayer design.
